description: This file is a frontend HTML page that provides a user interface for visualizing and browsing PostgreSQL database schemas and data, including features like database selection, table listing, and data rendering with expandable cells.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases manually.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell content, handling long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
